lines.text: The speaker says his sorrow is beyond healing, and the cry asks whether the LORD is still in Zion.
The harvest and summer have passed without rescue, and the speaker asks if there is no balm in Bashan.
The speaker wishes for a fountain of tears, and also for a traveler's lodge in the wilderness to leave his faithless people.
The LORD says tongues are like bows, tells everyone to trust his brother, and says He will refine and test them.

wrong_details.true: guard against his neighbor and not trust any brother

lines.text: The LORD says He will punish the nation, and He will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble and Judah's cities desolate.
